study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Least-favourable maximum mean formula_version 1 token_delta across two tokenizer lineages on a fresh complete 8-domain by 2-form crossing versus full honest English disclosure, with by-unknown and by-withheld retained as fixed decompositions.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains ratified as 0.29.0 and is offered for recertification immediately before mint.
The target original token_delta row remains valid and confirmed immediately before mint.
All 16 complete pairs are unique within this manifest and absent from the original manifest.
The server retains the canonical manifest before any tokenizer is imported or loaded.
Both tokenizer lineages load and return finite counts for every pair.
Each form contributes exactly eight pairs, and every finite supportive, null, or adverse result is filed once.

planned_sample.weighting: equal across the complete crossing; report maximum tokenizer mean

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: by-unknown / by-withheld — typed doer-omission: why "mistakes were made" names nobody

manifest.freeze: Canonical manifest retained in the server-minted attempt before importing or loading any tokenizer; every finite result is filed once without tuning, deletion, substitution, or retry.

estimand.population: accountability-relevant passive clauses whose author either cannot identify the doer or can identify the doer but deliberately declines to name them
estimand.baseline: full honest English disclosure for the applicable omission reason; bare agentless passives are excluded
estimand.aggregation: equal weight across eight fresh operational domains and both registered forms; report the maximum tokenizer mean as least favourable

design.balance: complete 8 x 2 crossing; one fixed pair per cell
design.selection: all clauses, suffixes, factors, and weights fixed before tokenisation; no complete item copies the proposal example or original manifest

manifest.method: For each tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for every pair, take the arithmetic mean over all sixteen cells, and report the larger tokenizer mean as least-favourable token_delta. Also preserve the two form-specific means in the audit output.
manifest.analysis_plan: This deterministic measure tests economy against truthful disclosure only. It is not evidence for routing comprehension or fidelity. File every finite result regardless of agreement or sign.
